verdict.rationale: Mem0 Open Source is documented as the same memory engine as the Platform, running on your own infrastructure, with a self-hosted Docker stack that includes a REST server and dashboard. That covers self-hosting and owning the stack. The evidence never shows in-process embedding as a library or running against local models, so a fully cloud-free setup is implied rather than demonstrated. missing for 10: documented in-process/embedded library mode, documented local LLM and embedding model support (no cloud API calls), explicit confirmation of no cloud dependency, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the memory layer fully locally — embedded in-process or against local models — without any cloud dependency

citations.quote: Mem0 Open Source is the same memory engine as the Platform, running on your own infrastructure. You own the stack, the data, and every component
Self-host Mem0 with full control over your infrastructure and data
As a self-hosted server. A Docker stack with a dashboard, per-user API keys, and a request audit log.
